change_message.description: A short description of the change.

data_source_url.description: The page's data source: a URL returning JSON whose values fill its `[[ key ]]` placeholders (`[[ stats.open ]]` for nested keys). Only domains the wiki allows work. `""` removes it.

data_source_ttl.description: Seconds to cache the data source's response, from 10 to 86400 (a day); 300 by default.
